captures.what_is_new: From Saturday 7 November the site publishes two editions a day in summit week: a morning edition (what is on today) and an evening edition (what happened and what is next). Each is a public page and a short plain-text email made from it, with links. Subscribers and sending are handled by the Web Summit team, not on the site.
